title: Receptionist / Administrator
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Receptionist / Administrator to join a well-established law firm offering a broad range of legal services to individuals and businesses.

As a Receptionist / Administrator, you will be providing front-of-house and administrative support while ensuring clients and visitors receive a professional and efficient service.

This role offers a competitive salary and benefits.

You will be responsible for:
- Managing reception and operating the main switchboard.
- Greeting clients and visitors in a professional and welcoming manner.
- Maintaining records relating to Wills, Deeds and Enduring Powers of Attorney.
- Responding to enquiries from clients, external contacts and colleagues regarding document storage and retrieval.
- Requesting identification and authorisation before releasing confidential documents.
- Locating, scanning and logging legal documents.
- Managing the storage, retrieval and disposal of files in accordance with procedures.
- Handling day-to-day enquiries from clients and Fee Earners.
- Filing paperwork and maintaining accurate records.
- Ensuring confidential information is handled securely and in line with GDPR requirements.

What we are looking for:
- Previously worked as a Receptionist, Legal Receptionist, Administrator, Office Receptionist, Front of House Receptionist, Office Administrator, Administration Assistant or in a similar role.
- Prior experience in a receptionist, front-of-house or administrative role.
- Confident and professional telephone manner.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Good organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook and Excel.
- Professional, approachable and client-focused manner.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Receptionist to develop your legal career within a respected and supportive practice.

Important Information: We endeavour to process your personal data in a fair and transparent manner. In applying for this role, Additional Resources will be acting in your best interest and may contact you in relation to the role, either by email, phone or text message. For more information see our Privacy Policy on our website. It is important you are aware of your individual rights and the provisions the company has put in place to protect your data. If you would like further information on the policy or GDPR please contact us.

Additional Resources Ltd is an Employment Business and an Employment Agency as defined within The Conduct of Employment Agencies & Employment Businesses Regulations 2003.

title: Department Administrator
description:
Job Title: Department Administrator

Location: Uckfield, East Sussex

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Salary: £27,000 - £28,000 + benefits

Our client is seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Administration Assistant to join their busy team based in Uckfield.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced office environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the administration of new claims, ensuring accurate case setup, maintaining records, and delivering excellent service to both private and corporate clients.

This is a varied administrative position requiring excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail, and confidence working across multiple databases and case management systems.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the new claims email inbox
- Setting up new files and cases by accurately entering information and documentation onto the case management system from multiple databases
- Reviewing documentation to ensure files are set up accurately and efficiently
- Preparing client care letters and compliance documentation
- Processing incoming post, scanning, and saving documents onto the case management system
- Answering and directing telephone enquiries in a professional manner
- Printing and preparing documentation for postal dispatch
- Providing regular updates to both private and corporate clients
- Updating records and maintaining accurate client information across multiple systems
- Assisting the team with general administrative and office support tasks as required
- Prioritising workload effectively to meet deadlines within a busy environment

Requirements
- Previous administration, office support, or coordinator experience
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Confident using Microsoft 365 applications
- Ability to learn and work confidently with a variety of case management and database systems
- Experience accurately transferring and maintaining data across multiple systems
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
- Professional, reliable, and client-focused approach
- Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment

Benefits
- Free on-site parking
- 20 days' annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Additional birthday holiday after 12 months' service
- Full-time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm (including a one-hour lunch break)
- Four-month probationary period

If you are interested in this opportunity, please click 'APPLY NOW' and a consultant from our Eastbourne branch will be in contact.

title: Project Administrator
description:
Project Administrator
- Location: Crawley
- Salary: 28,000 to 32,000
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Join a dynamic and fast-paced organisation as a Project Administrator. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on structure, enjoys working across teams and takes pride in keeping projects running smoothly behind the scenes. You will play a vital role in coordinating project activities, maintaining documentation and ensuring deadlines are met, all while supporting project managers and stakeholders with accurate and timely information.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Provide administrative support across multiple projects, ensuring tasks are completed on time and to a high standard.
- Maintain project documentation, including plans, reports, risk logs and meeting minutes.
- Schedule and coordinate meetings, workshops and stakeholder communications.
- Track project progress and assist with reporting on milestones, budgets and deliverables.
- Liaise with internal departments and external partners to support project delivery.
- Monitor deadlines and follow up on outstanding actions.
- Assist with procurement, invoicing and resource coordination where required.
- Ensure compliance with internal processes and project governance standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Previous experience in a project support or administrative role.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel, Word, and Outlook); experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Asana, Trello) is a plus.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
- Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunities for career development and project management training.
- A collaborative and inclusive working culture.
- Exposure to high-impact projects and cross-functional teams.
- Modern office facilities and flexible working options.

If you are interested in this vacancy, please apply as soon as possible.

title: Care Home Administrator
description:
Barchester Healthcare are looking for an experienced and dedicated Administrator to join our team and play a pivotal role within the home's management team. Providing the General Manager with the support needed to ensure the efficient running of a high quality home, this varied position encompasses managing Customer Experience elements alongside, HR, Recruitment, Payroll, Finance and the supervision of junior members of the administration team. You'll need to be a self-sufficient and professional individual who is enthusiastic and promotes a positive image when communicating with others and talking about the home, creating a positive impression. Along with strong IT skills and excellent organisation, our Administrators will need to be comfortable in giving others direction.

RESPONSIBILITIESPromote a warm and welcoming environment for residents, staff and visitorsManage enquiries and showrounds of the home for prospective families, including managing the customer database appropriately to support the commercial performance and conversion of enquiries for the homeDrive the occupancy and reputation of the Care Home as part of a community engagement team Support resident and family feedback with a focus on customer care Assist with the recruitment of home staff, completing employment new starter checks and arranging inductionsPayroll preparation for home based staffProvide advice and guidance to employees on queries using the HR tools and resources availableEnsure that all personal files are stored securely Attend meetings and produce accurate notes and minutes where requiredEnsure all rotas are completeManage safe contents, petty cash, and resident fund accountsUpdate ad-hoc training, supervisions, and appraisals on staff recordsOffer guidance on staff development opportunities including signposting to Apprenticeships and qualifications

NEED TO HAVEExperience in a customer facing rolePrevious involvement in HR administration and recruitment High level of attention to detail and the ability to prioritiseProficient user of Microsoft- specifically Word, Excel and OutlookCIPD qualification would be beneficial

REWARDS AND BENEFITSRewarding Excellence bonus, meaning you will be financially rewarded by up to £500 for a Good or Outstanding CQC inspectionUnlimited access to our generous refer a friend scheme, earning up to £500 per referralAccess to a wide range of retail and leisure discounts at big brands and supermarketsFree access to medical specialists, who are available for a second opinion if you need it to make a decision with confidenceConfidential and free access to counselling and legal servicesTax code review service, where we will check that you are on the right code and paying the right level of taxOption to join our monthly staff lottery alongside thousands of colleagues across the UK

As the only healthcare provider to be accredited as one of the best companies to work for in the UK, Barchester are dedicated to ensuring that our team are respected and their contribution valued. If you are looking to develop your administrative career with an employer that is supportive and offers progression opportunities, Barchester is an empowering and rewarding place to be.

title: Dispatch Administrator
description:
Shipping Coordinator
- Job Type: Full-time
- Location: Crawley
- Salary: £30,000 to £35,000

We are recruiting for a Shipping Coordinator to join a busy and fast-paced operations team, playing a key role in ensuring all customer orders are delivered on time and in full. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating daily dispatch activities, booking shipments, preparing export and delivery documentation, and ensuring all orders are processed accurately and efficiently.

This position requires close collaboration with internal teams, customers, suppliers and courier partners, handling both routine shipping requirements and more complex logistics enquiries. The role would suit a highly organised individual with strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills and previous experience within shipping, dispatch, logistics or supply chain operations.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Booking same-day couriers over the phone and via email.
- Managing overnight dispatches on courier systems.
- Liaising with couriers for collections and deliveries.
- Managing the dispatch inbox, resolving internal and external queries from customers or suppliers.
- Booking worldwide shipments and completing all necessary export documents.
- Resolving any export document queries with couriers.
- Ensuring clear and proactive communication with customers, couriers, and suppliers to guarantee timely deliveries.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and over the telephone.
- Customer-oriented attitude with the ability to work well under pressure.
- High attention to detail with excellent time management and organizational skills.
- Teamwork is crucial; must be able to work effectively with others.
- Exposure to operations and sales functions is advantageous, as this role requires close liaison with both departments.
- Sound knowledge of logistics processes.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and MS Outlook or similar.
- Good knowledge of CRM systems is beneficial.
- A counterbalance license is desirable but not essential.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary package.
- Opportunities for professional growth and development.
- Dynamic and supportive work environment.

If you are interested in this position, please apply as soon as possible

title: Care Coordinator
description:
An excellent opportunity has become available for an experienced Care Coordinator to join a well-established, privately owned domiciliary care provider in Eastbourne.

Working alongside the Registered Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the delivery of safe, high-quality, person-centred care. This is a varied role that includes managing staff and client rotas, coordinating care packages, completing client assessments and person-centred care plans, and maintaining compliance with CQC regulations. You will also provide support within the community when required and participate in the on-call rota.

This opportunity would suit someone with previous experience as a Care Coordinator or in a similar role within domiciliary care who enjoys building relationships, supporting care teams and delivering excellent customer service.

Requirements
- Previous experience as a Care Coordinator or similar within domiciliary care.
- Good understanding of CQC regulations and person-centred care planning.
- Experience completing client assessments and care plans.
- Strong communication, organisational and IT skills.
- Willingness to undertake care visits when required.

Responsibilities
- Supporting the Registered Manager with the day-to-day coordination of the service.
- Managing staff and client rotas to ensure the effective delivery of care.
- Completing client assessments and person-centred care plans.
- Liaising with clients, families, care staff and healthcare professionals.
- Ensuring care is delivered in line with CQC requirements.
- Participating in the on-call rota.

Remuneration & Benefits
- £29,000 - £30,000 per annum.
- Bonus incentive scheme.
- 28 days annual leave.
- Company pension.
- Referral programme.
- Bereavement leave.
- Ongoing training and career development.
- Full-time, permanent position.

Please contact Jade at Bright Selection for further information.

Bright Selection advertises roles on behalf of our clients. If you do not hear back from us within three working days of your application, unfortunately you have not been successful on this occasion. However, we may retain your details on our database for future opportunities and will notify you by email if we do so.

title: Office Coordinator
description:
Premier Work Support is delighted to be recruiting on behalf of one of our longstanding clients for a Temporary Office Coordinator to join their friendly and supportive team based in Horsham.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive individual who enjoys a varied role. Working closely with the General Manager, you will play a key part in supporting the day-to-day running of the office, ensuring administrative processes are completed accurately and operations run efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing sales orders accurately and efficiently.
- Managing and updating pricing books.
- Handling short-term hire enquiries and bookings.
- Assisting with stock administration.
- Liaising with drivers regarding operational queries and daily updates.
- Answering incoming telephone calls and directing enquiries appropriately.
- Greeting customers and visitors in a professional and welcoming manner.
- Supporting bank holiday planning and staff holiday coordination.
- Providing administrative support to the General Manager, including rota management.
- Completing labelling and assisting with operational or production tasks during quieter periods when required.
- Carrying out general administrative duties to support the wider business.
- Full training will be provided.

About You
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- A confident communicator with a professional and friendly manner.
- Comfortable speaking with customers and colleagues both over the phone and face-to-face.
- Able to work independently and learn new processes quickly.
- Reliable, proactive and willing to support wherever required.
- Calm under pressure with good organisational and time management skills.
- Comfortable carrying out routine administrative tasks accurately and consistently.
- A positive team player with a flexible approach to work.
- Previous office administration experience is preferred, although candidates with strong organisational skills and the right attitude will also be considered.

Essential Requirements
- Good numeracy skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Excellent spoken and written English.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a varied workload.

Hours

Monday to Friday: 8:00am - 5:00pm Friday: Early finish, dependent on business requirements.
